title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
blurb: Three separate attempts to continue the 1974 original, each ignoring the others. The 2017 prequel reaches back furthest.

t90.t: Leatherface: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre III

t95.t: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Next Generation

t06.t: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning

note: Leatherface is a prequel to the 1974 film, while The Beginning is a prequel to the 2003 remake — two different origin stories for the same character. Both Texas Chainsaw 3D and the 2022 film are direct sequels to 1974 that ignore each other.
